openQuestions.text: Class unlock quests: the path guide ties one quest to each class (Ladon Loach: Cataphract, Kothar Gar: Guardian, Sea-Star Stone: Dragoon); GameRant and the build notes say each class needs both quests of its chapter. Do both: every Send Supplies quest pays 5,500G and Renown.
A GameFAQs report says Dragoon can stay greyed out after Theodora's Ch 11 quests. Dragoon carries in from Cai's Aurora mentoring quest; if you skipped it, keep Lysander in Armored Ornius Rider.

The walkthrough sources give no location for Caltrop Flowers, White Trout, Black-Sand Steel, Melara, Thry Fruit, Roca, Venomstone, Desert Millet or Lir Fish; check each item's hover card for gather spots.
Whether materials gathered before a Send Supplies quest appears count toward it is not stated: hold them in inventory.
Whether loaning the ship to Anatolia blocks Theodora's sea travel until 9/21 is not stated: finish Lir Sea and Enno Isle trips first.
Whether Orchel's optional scene at Yu Phas' Temple is needed for Orchel's Paralogue is not stated; Diego depends on that Paralogue.
Whether Diego joins the moment Orchel's Paralogue ends, or needs a separate talk, is not stated.

Lv 35 per unit is not in the sources. Player data (lord about Lv 38 at the end of Part I, team 30 to 35, 7 to 8 Advanced) puts the exams in Ch 10 to 12; Sirocco, Loretta and Ultand are the least certain.
Deployment slots (about 6, then 7 to 8, then 9) come from a player report, and guests may take slots: check the prep screen each chapter.

Join levels are player data (Ch 6 to 8: about Lv 15, Beginner; Ch 9: Lv 15 or about 25, open; Ch 10+: about Lv 25, Specialty). Which Beginner class each Ch 6 to 9 recruit arrives in is unknown; Noctula joining Ch 8 as a Pugilist with the Claw is one player's report.
How much Class EXP a mastery takes is not documented (one GameFAQs player says it's much quicker than Three Houses, a comparison). Side-trip lengths are estimates: use the exit conditions.
Gambit Mt, Hit, range and uses are unpublished except Disturbing Volley's shape, and how much Cha adds is unknown: battalion picks rest on stat bonuses only.
Part II deploys up to 15 according to one source only: the plan brings exactly 15.
The Part II carry rule says "equipped": read here as each unit's own 6 items.
Sources don't say which chapter Loretta, Nydine, Ultand, Ninae, Simon, Diego, Zarcone or Sirocco first appear in Dagsion, or what Ultand's short quest asks: check Map > People every week.
No dish list exists for this route (the only dish data is from a Dietrich game): pick the dish where all three diners show a note icon.
Loretta's Pastry Cookbook at the Market Vendor comes from Game8 and is unconfirmed.
Game8 lists Caladrius as Cai-only; the plan assumes it carries in from Cai's route. Nobody here takes it.
Dagsion's Specialty License stock is not documented.
Masked Woods (Veroquine) has no route lock in RPG Site's dungeon list, but no Theodora-route source names its chest.
Whether Vandahl offers the Phantom Ring barter more than once is unknown: Alexandra's copy is the Northern Passage chest.
Sirocco's Sword rank on joining is not documented: he can't swing the Levin Sword (Sword C) until it reaches C.

How many battalions deploy at once at Renown 1, 5, 7 and 9 is unpublished. The plan fields Theodora, Ultand, Ninae, Sirocco, Sofia, Bonaventure, Tobias, Loretta, Lilian, Simon in that order and drops from the end.
Which tiers each town offers per Renown (when A tier first shows) is unknown: Divine-Shield Guard at Port of Pandora is planned for Renown 9.
Battalion use in Part II is undocumented; Part III keeps battalions in storage (Game8, thegameswiki) and assigned ones stay on Clear Data (GameFAQs).
Authority start ranks are unknown. The plan reads Theodora D (Rein) and E for units with no Authority seat (Tobias, Lilian, Loretta, Simon); Ultand's and Ninae's come from their build pages.

Unconfirmed for this army: fliers counting as [Cavalry] (Nydine stays on the ground), Noctula's Warrior's Clarity stacking, Nydine reaching Heavy for Cataphract under a bane, and whether Balor's gates count as obstacles for Unstoppable Force.

Support 3 for five recruits by Ch 9 rests on about 12 Sundays to the end of Ch 7 plus weekly gifts; the meal Support gain per table is not published. A recruit that misses its week joins one chapter later.
